app.tagline: See what is using your disk and slowing your PC

start.title: What do you want to scan?
start.folderHint: Faster than a whole drive when you already know where to look.
start.readOnly: Sizewise only reads your files. Nothing is changed or deleted.

errors.notAFolder: The Target is not a folder: {target}
errors.unreadable: The Target can't be read (access denied or unavailable): {target}

results.cancelled: This Scan was cancelled, so the result is incomplete. Sizes only cover what was read before cancelling.
results.unreadable: {count} folder couldn't be read, so totals may be incomplete. | {count} folders couldn't be read, so totals may be incomplete.

common.needsAdmin: Needs administrator: Windows only shares this with administrators.
common.cantUndo: This can't be undone by Sizewise.

overview.title: Overview
overview.intro: Measured facts about this PC, right now. You decide what to do about them.
overview.enabledItems: Startup item enabled | Startup items enabled
overview.disksFine: No disk reports a health problem. | The disk reports no health problem. | No disk reports a health problem ({count} disks).

startup.title: Startup items
startup.intro: Everything Windows launches when you sign in, for your account and for the whole PC.
startup.viewOnly: This list is view-only for now: turning Startup items on or off is coming in a later version. Task Manager's Startup tab can do it today.
startup.noDurations: Windows hasn't recorded a startup duration yet.
startup.noImpact: Windows doesn't share how much each item slows down startup, so Sizewise shows no impact rather than guess one.
startup.name: Name
startup.brokenHint: Its program file no longer exists: this is a leftover.

processes.title: Processes
processes.intro: What is running now and how much it uses. Refreshes every 1.5 seconds while this screen is open.
processes.ioNote: Read and Write count all file, disk and device I/O Windows reports for each process.
processes.name: Name
processes.criticalHint: Windows needs this process. Ending it could crash the PC, so Sizewise doesn't allow it.
processes.confirmBody: {name} (PID {pid}) will be closed immediately. Any unsaved work in it will be lost.
processes.accessDenied: Windows didn't allow ending {name}. It may need administrator rights.

programs.title: Installed programs
programs.intro: Programs installed for all users and for your account, largest first. Store apps aren't listed.
programs.name: Name
programs.measuredHint: Measured from the install folder; the program reports no size.
programs.confirmBody: The program's own uninstaller will open, and Windows may ask for administrator permission. Follow its steps to remove {name}.
programs.confirmUndo: Uninstalling can't be undone by Sizewise: nothing goes to the Recycle Bin.
programs.uninstallerClosed: The uninstaller of {name} closed. The list was refreshed.
programs.uninstallerMissing: The uninstaller of {name} no longer exists. Try removing it from Windows Settings.

disks.title: Disks
disks.intro: The health each physical disk reports, and how full each drive is.
disks.problemBody: The disk may fail soon. Back up the files you care about now.
